title: Not enough space to install updates
symptom: Windows Update fails with a message about not enough disk space
user_description: Windows keeps saying it can't install updates because there isn't enough space. What does that mean?

options.text: Delete user documents to make space
options.why: Never delete people's work to make room. Look for safe space first.

options.text: Turn off Windows Update so the error stops
options.why: Leaves the PC without security patches. It hides the symptom instead of solving it.

options.text: Free up space with Storage settings or Disk Cleanup, remove unused programs and temporary files, then retry the update
options.why: Updates need working space on the disk. Clearing temporary files and unused programs frees it safely without touching anyone's documents.

options.text: Delete files from the Windows folder
options.why: Dangerous. It can stop Windows from starting.

hints: What does Windows need on the disk to download and install an update?
Which files are safe to remove?
Which files must you never touch?
real_world_tip: Check how much space is free before and after. Many updates need several gigabytes of free room.
